paper.title_en: Universal Analytical Description of Magnetoexcitons in Two-Dimensional Semiconducting Materials
paper.abstract_en: Matching the Coulomb and logarithmic limits of the Rytova--Keldysh model gives a universal zero-field spectrum for monolayer exciton $s$ states, $E_n\simeq-\mathrm{Ry}^*/[n-1/2+f_n(ξ)]^2$, where $ξ$ is the screening parameter. Analytical radii determine diamagnetic coefficients and the magnetic crossover scale. Zero-field deviations peak near $1\%$ across the full screening range $0\leqξ\leq100$. For the sampled hBN-encapsulated monolayers, magnetoexciton energies agree with numerical spectra to sub-meV rms up to $100\T$ and capture the measured orbital shifts. Shared parameters link optical and magneto-optical spectra.
